title: Strategy-Based Settle-Up Service
instructions: In `settle_up.py` implement `net_balances`, the abstract `SettleUpStrategy`, the carry-forward `NaiveSettleUpStrategy`, `SettleUpService` and `build_dummy_expense`. The service must depend only on the strategy abstraction, include every expense a user takes part in (grouped or not), and return just the transactions relevant to the request.

evidence.label: Computes paid minus owed per user
Naive strategy chains payments through the next person in sorted order
Naive transactions clear all balances using at most n-1 transactions
settle_up_user returns only transactions involving that user, [] if unknown
settle_up_user feeds the strategy every expense the user is in, across groups
settle_up_group uses only that group's expenses
A dummy settlement expense moves balances; invalid amounts and users are rejected
The strategy is abstract and a different one can be swapped into the service
Transaction prints as 'payer pays receiver amount'; empty or even inputs give no transactions
